svg.title: Spatial Dynamic Compression overview with token allocation and selected-token zoom
svg.desc: Inventory: left frame contains stacked LLM, Spatial Dynamic Compression, Token Allocation, Frame Group Fusion, MLP, ViT, bottom video-frame strip, colored token blocks, gray up/down allocation arrows, and black connector lines. Right frame is a zoomed rounded panel connected by pale-blue guide lines from the SDC block; it contains a gridded image/token heatmap, a red trajectory/selection overlay, a selected-token matrix, three vertical operation blocks, and gray routing/bracket lines. Symmetry basis: the left pipeline is vertically layered with repeated token groups aligned on common horizontal centers; the right section is organized around a top heatmap and bottom vertical operation boxes with central routing symmetry.
